apps.name: Achilló
apps.subtitle: Guided Achilles rehab, by ear
apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Medial and lateral gastroc now look different: the medial head is bigger and reaches lower; the lateral head is smaller and ends higher. The other head shows faintly for comparison.
Readable names in the Calf map jump list (no more map_tp).
Calf map now shows the leg from the side you actually see (inner or outer), with bony landmarks and a measured line to each spot. During Get set the dot slides from the landmark to the spot.
